Search and AI answer analysisQuantum Business Solutions for GoodSuite

Search and AI answers, measured 9 September 2026

Where goodsuite.com stands, and what it is worth to fix

Every number here came from a Semrush or Firecrawl pull or from the live HTML of the site, fetched 9 September 2026. Where a pull was not made, the table says so. This is the baseline any work is measured against at 30, 60 and 90 days.

Readiness on sixteen checks, averaged over every page in the sitemap.

1,599organic keywords; about 52 percent of visits come from the two spellings of the brand name
534organic visits a month, worth about 3,485 dollars a month at Semrush's cost per click
0top-10 results for managed IT services Los Angeles, 1,900 searches a month, and for every other local query tested
16Authority Score, against 25 to 33 for the Los Angeles IT firms that hold the results

Top findings

Ranked by what they cost, with the fix

Each finding carries its evidence, what it costs today, and what we would do about it.

1 critical4 high5 medium2 low
1
Critical

Absent from every local service result tested, in every city GoodSuite serves

Evidence
Managed it services los angeles (1,900 searches a month) returns AllSafe IT, Cloudtango, Red River, CyberDuo, ITS, Exigent, CAL IT Group, Clutch, BTI and Cortavo. Managed print services los angeles returns IOTEC Digital, Orange County Copiers, Visual Edge IT, Onsite Laser Medic, IT Pros Management, TMG, Yelp, CDW, Office1 and DocuProducts. Managed it services fresno returns CIO Solutions, Visual Edge IT, Cloudtango, Unity IT, TeamLogic IT, Cosmistack, Datapath, Xobee, Clutch and MSP Database. Copier dealer chatsworth ca returns Performance Group, Printer Repair Pros, Yelp, Marathon Services, The UPS Store and four directories. GoodSuite has an office in Chatsworth and one in Fresno and appears in none of the forty results.
What it costs
Every buyer in Los Angeles, the San Fernando Valley, Ventura County and Fresno who does not already know the name is handed to a competitor, on every service line.
What we do
A page for each place GoodSuite works from: Chatsworth as headquarters, Los Angeles, Fresno and Ventura County, each with the address, hours, a LocalBusiness record, the services delivered from that office and a local FAQ marked up as FAQPage. Then one city page per service line for the two markets that search most, Los Angeles and Fresno.
2
High

Ninety-nine pages show a FAQ the crawler cannot read

Evidence
Ninety-nine of 317 pages carry an accordion of questions, including the home page, all ten service pages and the FAQ page itself with twenty questions. Not one page on the site has FAQPage schema. The pages that hold position one for managed it services los angeles (AllSafe IT, 4,486 words) and position four (CyberDuo, 3,147 words) both carry FAQPage, Question and Answer plus LocalBusiness and Service.
What it costs
The work of writing the answers is done and earns nothing. Google's FAQ rich results and every AI assistant that reads structured data pass GoodSuite by on the exact questions it has already answered.
What we do
Mark every existing accordion up as FAQPage with Question and Answer. It is markup, not copy: the ninety-nine pages move from 0 to 12 points each on the readiness score the day it ships.
3
High

Half the visits are the brand name and a quarter are accessory listings; the service pages earn nothing

Evidence
Goodsuite and good suite are 52 percent of organic visits and land on the home page. About 24 percent more land on shop.goodsuite.com product listings for a Canon carrying case, headsets, a Logitech mouse, a 1TB SSD and monitors. About 15 percent land on blog posts about MFPs, HIPAA printing and church printers. In the top 50 keywords not one lands on a service page.
What it costs
Someone who wants managed IT, managed print, cybersecurity or a copier lease and does not know GoodSuite has no page to arrive at. The site is a phone book for existing clients and a parts counter for bargain hunters.
What we do
Ten service pages rebuilt around the terms buyers use (managed IT services, managed print services, copier lease, cybersecurity services) with the city in the title, Service schema and the FAQ marked up, plus the location pages above. The shop stays where it is; it is a separate property and should be measured as one.
4
High

The site disagrees with itself about where GoodSuite is

Evidence
The service-areas page lists Los Angeles (HQ) at 5950 Canoga Ave, Woodland Hills first, Fresno second and 9629 Owensmouth Ave Suite 1, Chatsworth third. Yelp (5.0 from 3 reviews) and Facebook both list the Woodland Hills address. The headquarters is Chatsworth. No page carries LocalBusiness schema for any of the three offices; the Organization schema has no address at all.
What it costs
Google and every answer engine corroborate a business across its site, its map listing and its profiles before naming it. Three addresses in three orders is a reason not to.
What we do
One name, address and phone for each office, written the same way everywhere: Chatsworth as headquarters on the site, in Organization schema, on Google Business Profile, Yelp, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bing Places and the dealer locators. A LocalBusiness record per office on its own location page.
5
High

Schema lives on the blog, not on the money pages

Evidence
244 pages carry Service or Article schema, and 185 of them are blog posts with Article. The ten service pages carry Organization only: no Service, no Offer, no FAQPage, no LocalBusiness. Managed Print Services in California scores 59 of 100; Workflow Automation scores 48 with no question heading on the page.
What it costs
Assistants asked who provides managed print in Los Angeles find a structured answer on the IOTEC and Visual Edge pages and prose on GoodSuite's.
What we do
Service schema on each of the ten service pages with areaServed for the counties GoodSuite lists, provider pointing at the Organization, and the existing FAQ marked up.
6
Medium

Seventy-four pages have no meta description, fifteen have no H1 and nine have more than one

Evidence
Measured on all 317 URLs in the sitemap. Twenty-eight pages fall back to a theme image when shared. Thirteen titles carry a city; the service titles say in California, which is no city at all.
What it costs
Google writes its own snippet for a quarter of the site and the shared cards show a stock image.
What we do
A title of 30 to 60 characters with the city, a meta description of 70 to 160 characters ending on a sentence, one H1 and a real image on every page. The workbook lists every page that needs each.
7
Medium

Twenty booking pages of 78 words each, two per service, sit in the index

Evidence
/managed-print-book-demo/ and /book-a-meeting-for-managed-print/ are the same page twice, and the pattern repeats for all ten services. With the request forms there are 41 form pages in the sitemap, 13 percent of the site, averaging 42 of 100.
What it costs
Crawl budget and internal link equity spent on pages that should never rank, and near-duplicate content Google has to resolve.
What we do
One booking page per service, the other redirected; noindex on every request and thank-you form; the sitemap trimmed to pages meant to rank.
8
Medium

Three hosts answer for the company

Evidence
goodsuite.com is the canonical host and the technical checks pass: https, one canonical, sitemap declared, llms.txt served, every AI crawler allowed. But www3.goodsuite.com is indexed and holds position four for goodsuite reviews, and shop.goodsuite.com carries about a quarter of organic visits with no path back to the services.
What it costs
Authority split three ways, and a buyer who searches the reviews lands on a stray subdomain.
What we do
www3 redirected to the canonical host, page for page. The shop kept as a separate property with a link to the service pages in its header and a canonical policy written down.
9
Medium

A 245-post blog, re-dated in one month and filed in ten drawers

Evidence
Every post in the sitemap carries a last-modified date between March and August 2026; 191 of them are March 2026, which is a migration, not a publishing schedule. Posts sit under blog (173), testimonials (14), chqs-blog (13), uncategorized-pages (12), forms (12), news (8), uncategorized (5), case-studies (3), chqs-news (3) and webinar (2). The old brand, Copier Headquarters, still ranks second for its own name and lives on in /category/chqs-news/. Posts average 1,156 words and 185 carry Article schema, the strongest part of the site.
What it costs
Depth without structure. The posts that rank (MFPs, HIPAA printing, church printers, office copiers at position 9) do not point at a service page that could convert the reader.
What we do
One /blog/ tree by service line, BlogPosting with an honest datePublished, a named author as a Person, articleSection set to the service, and a link from each post to the service page it supports. Copier Headquarters redirected and acknowledged on the about page.
10
Medium

Reviews exist off the site and are not on it

Evidence
Yelp 5.0 from 3 reviews on the Woodland Hills listing, Facebook 5.0 from 1, Glassdoor 3.4 from 11 as an employer, Indeed 4.0 from 3. The Google Business Profile rating was not pulled. The site has 14 testimonial posts and no Review or AggregateRating schema. For goodsuite reviews the site's own pages do not appear in the top eight except the www3 subdomain.
What it costs
Reviews are the strongest local ranking signal after proximity and the first thing an assistant cites when asked whether a company is any good.
What we do
A review program that asks every closed ticket for a Google review, a reviews page that embeds the Google reviews rather than self-published testimonials, and the Yelp listing moved to the Chatsworth address.
11
Low

Titles name the state, not the city

Evidence
Managed IT Services in California, Managed Cybersecurity Services in California, Managed Print Services in California. Thirteen of 317 titles carry a city, five of them blog posts. The Los Angeles pages that rank all carry Los Angeles in the title.
What it costs
California is not a place a buyer searches from; Los Angeles and Fresno are.
What we do
City-bearing titles on the service and location pages, generated from one rule so they stay consistent.
12
Low

Authority is directory and wire links, not local ones

Evidence
Authority Score 16 with 546 referring domains. The strongest are Yahoo, Bing, ZoomInfo, Crunchbase, PR Newswire, Yellow Pages and Birdeye. The Los Angeles IT firms that rank score 25 to 33. IOTEC Digital ranks first for managed print in Los Angeles at Authority Score 14, below GoodSuite, because it has the page.
What it costs
Small. Authority is not what is missing; pages are. But the gap widens every quarter it is ignored.
What we do
Dealer locator listings (Sharp, Canon, Kyocera, Lexmark, Datto, Microsoft partner directory), the Chatsworth and Fresno chambers, and the associations GoodSuite already belongs to, each with the Chatsworth address.

Highest leverage moves

Five moves, in the order we would make them

The five moves with the biggest return for the least effort, in the order we would do them. Each one is either in the build or in the first 30 days of the plan.

1

Mark up the ninety-nine FAQs that already exist

Days 1 to 10First 30 days

The accordions on the home page, the ten service pages, the FAQ page and 87 posts become FAQPage with Question and Answer. No copy changes. It is the single largest score move on the site, 12 points on each of 99 pages, and it makes every answer GoodSuite has already written visible to the engines that answer questions.

2

One address, and a page for each office, Chatsworth first

Days 1 to 30First 30 days

Chatsworth becomes the headquarters everywhere: the service-areas page, Organization schema, Google Business Profile, Yelp, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bing Places. Then a location page for Chatsworth, Los Angeles, Fresno and Ventura County, each with LocalBusiness schema, the services delivered from that office, hours, a map and a local FAQ. Copier dealer chatsworth ca has no GoodSuite result today; it should have the first one.

3

Rebuild the ten service pages around the terms buyers use

Days 10 to 45First 60 days

Managed IT services, managed print services, copier lease, cybersecurity services, backup and disaster recovery, private cloud, VoIP phone systems: each page gets the city in the title, a meta description, one H1, Service schema with areaServed, the FAQ marked up, and the questions from the Semrush pull answered in the first sentence. Then the Los Angeles and Fresno variants for managed IT, which together are 2,490 searches a month with no GoodSuite result.

4

Trim the index: booking pages, forms and the third host

Days 10 to 30First 30 days

One booking page per service, the duplicate redirected. Noindex on 41 form pages. www3.goodsuite.com redirected page for page to goodsuite.com. Seventy-four meta descriptions and fifteen H1s written from the workbook. The sitemap then lists only pages meant to rank.

5

One blog tree, and a review program

Days 30 to 90By day 90

The 245 posts move under /blog/ by service line with BlogPosting, a named author and a link to the service page each supports. Copier Headquarters is redirected and acknowledged. Every closed ticket asks for a Google review; a reviews page embeds them. The report is re-run at 30, 60 and 90 days against this baseline.

The blog

Two hundred and forty-five posts, re-dated in a month and filed in ten drawers

Every post in the sitemap, parsed the same way as the pages. The depth is real; the structure and the dates are not.

245posts in the sitemap; 191 carry a March 2026 date, which is a migration
1,156words per post on average, the deepest content on the site
185posts with Article schema; none with FAQPage, none with a named author as a Person
10taxonomies, including chqs-blog, uncategorized and forms

What we found

  • The blog is where GoodSuite ranks: mfps (position 5, 720 searches), office copiers (9, 1,000), commercial printers (18, 1,900), hipaa compliant printing (3, 260), best printer for church (4, 140), types of managed it services (16, 880).
  • Not one of those posts links to the service page that could convert the reader; the managed IT post points nowhere near the managed IT page.
  • Copier Headquarters, the old brand, ranks second for its own name and its posts live under /chqs-blog/ and /category/chqs-news/ with no explanation of the rename.
  • Fourteen testimonials and twelve forms are published as posts and appear in the post sitemap.

What we would do

First 60 days One /blog/ tree by service line. Each post gets BlogPosting with an honest datePublished and dateModified, a named author as a Person, articleSection set to the service line, and a link to the service page it supports.

First 30 days Testimonials and forms removed from the post type. Copier Headquarters redirected to the about page, where the rename is stated once so an assistant can connect the two names.

Ongoing One post a month per service line, written to answer a question from the Semrush pull, with the FAQ marked up.

Social and the entity

What connects the company across the web

Answer engines corroborate a company across the web before they name it. GoodSuite's profiles exist and disagree about the address; the site connects LinkedIn and Facebook and nothing else.

3addresses in play: Woodland Hills on Yelp, Facebook and the site's HQ line; Chatsworth as the real headquarters; Fresno
25+years in business per LinkedIn; the Organization schema carries no foundingDate
546referring domains, led by Yahoo, Bing, ZoomInfo, Crunchbase and PR Newswire
yesllms.txt served and every AI crawler allowed: the plumbing is right

What we found

  • The Organization schema carries name, URL and logo. It has no address, no telephone, no foundingDate and sameAs for LinkedIn and Facebook only.
  • Yelp and Facebook list 5950 Canoga Ave, Woodland Hills. The service-areas page lists it as Los Angeles (HQ). The company is at 9629 Owensmouth Ave Suite 1, Chatsworth, CA 91311.
  • ZoomInfo and Crunchbase link to the site; neither is linked from it. The Glassdoor profile (3.4 from 11) outranks every GoodSuite page for the reviews query.

What we would do

First 30 days Organization schema with the Chatsworth address, telephone, foundingDate and sameAs to LinkedIn, Facebook, Yelp, Crunchbase, ZoomInfo and the Google Business Profile; each office as a LocalBusiness on its own page with the parent Organization named.

First 30 days Every profile moved to the Chatsworth address, written identically.

Where the traffic comes from

Today, in numbers

  • Semrush US database: 1,599 organic keywords, 534 visits a month, traffic value about 3,485 dollars a month. The two brand spellings are about 52 percent of visits; shop.goodsuite.com accessory listings about 24 percent; blog posts about 15 percent; service pages none of the top 50.
  • Authority Score 16, 546 referring domains, 5,768 backlinks, 4,021 of them followed. The Los Angeles IT firms holding the results score 25 (AllSafe IT), 27 (CyberDuo) and 33 (Visual Edge IT); IOTEC Digital ranks first for managed print in Los Angeles at 14.
  • Live results 9 September 2026 from Los Angeles and Fresno: absent from the top ten for managed it services los angeles, managed print services los angeles, copier lease los angeles, copier dealer chatsworth ca, managed it services fresno and cybersecurity services for small business los angeles.
  • 317 URLs in the sitemap, average readiness 57 of 100: no page scores A, 96 score D or F. No FAQPage on any page while 99 show a FAQ; no LocalBusiness; no Review schema; 74 pages without a meta description.
  • Technical: https with one canonical host, sitemap declared, llms.txt served, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended all allowed. Two more hosts answer: www3.goodsuite.com (indexed, ranks for the reviews query) and shop.goodsuite.com.
  • Where the blog ranks: mfps 5, office copiers 9, hipaa compliant printing 3, best printer for church 4, commercial printers 18, types of managed it services 16. Copier headquarters, the old name, position 2.

The 90-day plan

What happens, in order

Days 1 to 10

Baseline locked: this report, a Semrush project on the domain, Search Console verified, Google Business Profile claimed for Chatsworth, Los Angeles and Fresno at one written address each. FAQPage markup shipped on the 99 pages that already show a FAQ.

Days 10 to 30

Location pages for Chatsworth, Los Angeles, Fresno and Ventura County with LocalBusiness schema. Organization schema completed. www3 redirected. One booking page per service, forms set to noindex, 74 meta descriptions and 15 H1s written from the workbook.

Days 30 to 60

The ten service pages rebuilt with Service schema, city titles and the questions answered; the Los Angeles and Fresno managed IT pages published. Report re-run at day 30.

Days 60 to 90

Blog moved to one tree by service line with BlogPosting and authors; each ranking post linked to its service page. Review program live. Dealer-locator and chamber listings placed with the Chatsworth address. Report re-run at day 60.

Day 90

Report re-run against this baseline: readiness, local positions for the six queries, non-brand share, Google review count. The next 90 days planned from what moved.

In one list

  1. Absent from every local service result tested, in every city GoodSuite serves. A page for each place GoodSuite works from: Chatsworth as headquarters, Los Angeles, Fresno and Ventura County, each with the address, hours, a LocalBusiness record, the services delivered from that office and a local FAQ marked up as FAQPage. Then one city page per service line for the two markets that search most, Los Angeles and Fresno.
  2. Ninety-nine pages show a FAQ the crawler cannot read. Mark every existing accordion up as FAQPage with Question and Answer. It is markup, not copy: the ninety-nine pages move from 0 to 12 points each on the readiness score the day it ships.
  3. Half the visits are the brand name and a quarter are accessory listings; the service pages earn nothing. Ten service pages rebuilt around the terms buyers use (managed IT services, managed print services, copier lease, cybersecurity services) with the city in the title, Service schema and the FAQ marked up, plus the location pages above. The shop stays where it is; it is a separate property and should be measured as one.
  4. The site disagrees with itself about where GoodSuite is. One name, address and phone for each office, written the same way everywhere: Chatsworth as headquarters on the site, in Organization schema, on Google Business Profile, Yelp, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bing Places and the dealer locators. A LocalBusiness record per office on its own location page.
  5. Schema lives on the blog, not on the money pages. Service schema on each of the ten service pages with areaServed for the counties GoodSuite lists, provider pointing at the Organization, and the existing FAQ marked up.
  6. Seventy-four pages have no meta description, fifteen have no H1 and nine have more than one. A title of 30 to 60 characters with the city, a meta description of 70 to 160 characters ending on a sentence, one H1 and a real image on every page. The workbook lists every page that needs each.
  7. Twenty booking pages of 78 words each, two per service, sit in the index. One booking page per service, the other redirected; noindex on every request and thank-you form; the sitemap trimmed to pages meant to rank.
  8. Three hosts answer for the company. www3 redirected to the canonical host, page for page. The shop kept as a separate property with a link to the service pages in its header and a canonical policy written down.
  9. A 245-post blog, re-dated in one month and filed in ten drawers. One /blog/ tree by service line, BlogPosting with an honest datePublished, a named author as a Person, articleSection set to the service, and a link from each post to the service page it supports. Copier Headquarters redirected and acknowledged on the about page.
  10. Reviews exist off the site and are not on it. A review program that asks every closed ticket for a Google review, a reviews page that embeds the Google reviews rather than self-published testimonials, and the Yelp listing moved to the Chatsworth address.
  11. Titles name the state, not the city. City-bearing titles on the service and location pages, generated from one rule so they stay consistent.
  12. Authority is directory and wire links, not local ones. Dealer locator listings (Sharp, Canon, Kyocera, Lexmark, Datto, Microsoft partner directory), the Chatsworth and Fresno chambers, and the associations GoodSuite already belongs to, each with the Chatsworth address.

Every number here came from a Semrush or Firecrawl pull, or from the live HTML of goodsuite.com, on 9 September 2026. Where a pull was not made, the table says so. Rankings and traffic are not promised; the inputs are, and they are re-measured against this baseline.
